Subject: Quick engineering sync before product walkthrough

Hi Samir / Priya —

Thanks for signing up and for the interest in Redwood. Before we sit down for the full product walkthrough with Marissa, would you be open to a very short (15-min) technical check with one of our engineers? It helps us confirm the integration shape and prioritize the demo so we can focus on the bits that matter (auth, data flow, inference latency expectations).

Suggested agenda (15 minutes):
- One-sentence on your goal and current flow
- Any networking/KMS constraints we should know about
- Confirm sample payload size and concurrency expectations

If that works, here are two windows tomorrow (PDT):
- Wed 7/1, 10:00–10:15am
- Wed 7/1, 2:30–2:45pm

If neither works, reply with a couple times or use my 15-min slot link: https://calendly.com/redwood-inference/15min-eng-check

I’ll loop in our SE (Dev) if you pick a slot.

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
SDR, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

Attachment: pre-demo-checklist.pdf (short checklist we often send ahead of engineering syncs)

- We're in PDT.
- Primary goals: validate routing for multi-region inference, and confirm that we can keep logs off the model path (compliance req).
- Our infra lead (me) will attend — I prefer earlier in the day.

Prefer 7/1 10:00am if that slot is available. Can you confirm who from your side will join and if you can share a short tech summary (networking, auth options)?
